fields.label: Accommodation sub heading
fields.name: accommodation_sub_heading
fields.instructions: A short intro heading that describes your place. Example: "Peaceful place, 2mins walk to beach good for 2"

fields.label: Custom accommodation short description
fields.name: custom_accommodation_short_description
fields.instructions: A short intro description that describes your place.

fields.label: Pricing mode
fields.name: pricing_mode
fields.instructions: How this listing is priced. "Single rate" uses the Nightly/Monthly rate fields above.

fields.label: Room types
fields.name: accommodation_room_types
fields.instructions: One row per room type. The cheapest room becomes the card "from" price.

fields.label: Additional bed rate (PHP)
fields.name: additional_bed_rate
fields.instructions: Optional. Cost of an extra bed.

fields.label: Base rate (PHP / night)
fields.name: per_pax_base_rate
fields.instructions: Price covering up to the base pax below.

fields.label: Base pax included
fields.name: per_pax_base_pax
fields.instructions: Guests covered by the base rate (e.g. 4).

fields.label: Extra per pax (PHP)
fields.name: per_pax_extra_rate
fields.instructions: Added per guest beyond the base pax.

fields.label: Extra charges (add-ons)
fields.name: pricing_extras
fields.instructions: Optional add-on charges shown under the price. Free-text label, e.g. Adult ₱300, Young adult ₱200, Pet fee. Works with any pricing mode.

fields.label: What type of place will guests have?
fields.name: what_type_of_place_will_guests_have

fields.label: FAQ amenities
fields.name: faq_amenities
fields.instructions: Add at least 8 featured amenities or exclusions that you want your client to know.

fields.label: Pin location
fields.name: accommodation_location
fields.instructions: Preferably your google my business address if available.
